name: iron vambraces
_design_note: F20-60 medium arms slot. Riveted plate from wrist to elbow. Covers iron_bracers, bronze_bracers, chain_bracers, scale_bracers from legacy data — material is the variation axis.
lore_template: A pair of {material_name} vambraces, each a single curved plate riveted around the forearm from wrist to elbow. Drill sergeants forbid blocking a blade with the arm. In close quarters it happens anyway, and these are why the arm survives.
